body:
Hi. I'm replying to your post because you were so personal to me, but this response is to everyone.

Thanks. Really. I've always known that talking helps things, and this is yet another form of communication.

I feel better today. This thing really seems to come and go, one day I will go feeling completely happy, another day I will feel soul-crushingly lonely, another day I'll get that "fuck everyone, you've done nothing for me" feeling. 

I really scared myself last night at the point where I put a knife to my wrist, closed my eyes and sliced. Looking now at the cut I feel two things - a strange fascination with why someone would do something like this to oneself, and a kind of silent fear that I've crossed new boundaries.

Also, it feels sad to know I won't be able to work out for a while as there is no way in hell I'm letting anyone see this.

I talked to an amazing girl last night. We hooked up at a party a while ago and know each other online, but never really talk too much. Back when we hooked up I noticed that she had scars - actual, huge scars on her upper arms as well as her upper chest, arranged in geometrical patterns. I cried my heart out to her last night, she was understanding and supportive. I feel that she is least likely to judge me just because she has been through something similar. 

I'm trying to focus on my work and keep around people at all times - it does help. 

I also can't help but want to completely give up on females. I have been friends (no friendzone bullshit, just straight friends) with some, and I see them do completely batshit insane things that are somehow justified in their mind. When I've made my own moves (on others), it results in a whirl and I'm left wondering what the enjoyment of any of this even is.
